<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

Fixes #62031.

Reject a nonzero long-prefill cap smaller than the configured maximum multimodal item when item chunking is disabled. This replaces an accepted configuration that can permanently stall contended requests with an actionable startup error.

## Claims

- Validate the cap alongside the existing maximum-item versus batch-budget check.
- Cover fixed and adaptive caps; retain disabled-cap, equal/larger-cap, chunkable-input, and disabled-modality behavior.
- Preserve the scheduler, hard budgets, whole-item guard, and fairness policy. Defaults remain unchanged.

## Validation

On macOS arm64, Python 3.11.2, PyTorch 2.14.1, Transformers 5.19.0:

```bash
HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=cpu VLLM_PLUGINS='' PYTHONPATH=. \
  .venv/bin/python -m pytest \
  tests/v1/core/test_scheduler.py \
  tests/v1/core/test_encoder_cache_manager.py \
  tests/v1/core/test_async_scheduler.py -q
```

**269 passed in 50.67 seconds** on publication commit `776389ac699bdc3761cf596dd7ae8e6236a6da35`, based on upstream `8a6c0449b36e7aba29c2a6b1720ca3c08cfafa32`, including nine new cases. Before/after regressions were also checked at base `642c18d64c4cb6db3ded8fbe1786718cd4005fcb`: four rejection cases fail on unchanged production code and five valid controls pass. The five-file target patch is byte-identical after rebasing. The default commit hooks, sign-off hook, and current-head hook rerun pass, including mypy, Markdown lint, and CI test tethering; git diff --check passes. Existing CPU CI covers the tests. After removing the temporary CPU inference dependency, all nine new cases also pass in isolation with HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 and TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1; these flags avoid a DNS failure in the existing public-model configuration lookup.

At base `642c18d`, real CPU MRV1 inference was checked with a seeded local tiny LLaVA checkpoint, four image tokens, float32, and batch budget 128. Both image requests were queued while scheduling was paused, then resumed together to guarantee contention.

| Check | Baseline | Patch |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Cap 2, two queued image requests | Startup accepted; generation stalls until the 30-second watchdog | Intended ValueError at startup, reporting cap 2 and item maximum 4 |
| Cap 0, same requests | Both complete | Both complete; identical output tokens |
| Cap 4, same requests | Both complete | Both complete; identical output tokens |

Each valid run produces eight greedy tokens per request. The initial unpaused baseline run completed because overlap was not guaranteed; it is not counted as a stall reproduction.

Both inference checkouts temporarily included the same CPU slot-mapping compatibility change from [open PR #61151](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/61151), head 5e0ac9d76f4ddbfa8290f488cebca39645ff81a5. Its two native tests pass locally. Without that dependency, both versions fail in the same pre-existing CPU fallback. The dependency was removed after testing and is excluded from this PR.

GPU/MRV2, HTTP serving, and pretrained-model quality were not tested. No post-rebase inference rerun is claimed; the inference matrix is attributed to base `642c18d`.

## Details

The scheduler caps proposed prefill work before checking whole-image boundaries. If the cap is below an intact item, the boundary guard schedules zero tokens. With multiple eligible requests, the cap stays active and the same state repeats. The baseline remained stuck for 1,000 scheduling passes. Adaptive fair share can also stay below the item size.

The fix adds a 12-line check to compute_mm_encoder_budget, following its existing batch-budget validation. The error tells users to disable the cap with zero or raise it sufficiently. The optimization guide and field documentation explain that validation uses the configured maximum item size, even if a particular request is smaller or alone. Encoder-decoder configuration already resets the threshold to zero.

This matches the fail-fast approach proposed in the [review of #52412](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52412#pullrequestreview-5407246881), while preserving the merged boundary fixes in [#52412](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52412) and [#59721](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/59721). The proposal itself has not received maintainer approval.

Tradeoff: conservative startup rejection. A low cap that would work for one request, small images, or light adaptive contention is rejected because later requests could make it unschedulable. Default cap zero and configurations allowing item chunking are unaffected. No performance or output-quality improvement is claimed.

Duplicate searches on October 16, 2026 found no matching open cap-validation fix. [#59030](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/59030) changes waiting-queue requeueing. [#61733](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/61733) validates whole prompts when chunked prefill is disabled after startup; this validates a multimodal item's per-request cap in configurations that still allow chunked text prefill.

OpenAI Codex assisted with investigation, implementation, tests, and preparation. Publication was authorized by the human submitter. The automated validation commands described above were run by Codex; no human-executed validation is claimed. The commit includes AI attribution and the submitter's DCO sign-off.

- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.

@@ -79,6 +79,16 @@ llm = LLM(model="meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct", max_num_batched_tokens=16384
 
 See related papers for more details (<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2401.08671> or <https://arxiv.org/pdf/2308.16369>).
 
+### Multimodal Prefill Caps
+
+With `--disable-chunked-mm-input`, a nonzero `--long-prefill-token-threshold`
+must be at least the model's maximum tokens per multimodal item. Otherwise,
+initialization fails rather than allowing contended requests to stall. Set the
+threshold to `0` to disable the cap, or increase it to fit a whole item. Adaptive
+thresholds follow the same requirement because their fair share can shrink as
+more requests arrive. Validation uses the configured maximum item size, even
+when a particular request contains a smaller item or runs alone.
+
 ## Parallelism Strategies
 
 vLLM supports multiple parallelism strategies that can be combined to optimize performance across different hardware configurations.

 import pytest
 import torch
 
+from vllm.config import SchedulerConfig

 from vllm.v1.core.encoder_cache_manager import (
     EncoderCacheManager,
     EncoderDecoderCacheManager,
+    compute_mm_encoder_budget,
 )
 
 pytestmark = pytest.mark.cpu_test
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("adaptive", [False, True])
+def test_no_mm_chunking_rejects_small_prefill_cap(adaptive: bool):
+    config = SchedulerConfig(
+        is_encoder_decoder=False,
+        max_model_len=4096,
+        max_num_batched_tokens=2048,
+        disable_chunked_mm_input=True,
+        long_prefill_token_threshold=500,
+        long_prefill_token_threshold_adaptive=adaptive,
+    )
+    with pytest.raises(
+        ValueError,
+        match=r"long_prefill_token_threshold \(500\).*max_tokens_per_mm_item \(576\)",
+    ):
+        compute_mm_encoder_budget(config, {"image": 576})
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "cap,disable_mm_chunking,mm_tokens,expected_budget",
+    [
+        pytest.param(0, True, {"image": 576}, 2048, id="disabled-cap"),
+        pytest.param(576, True, {"image": 576}, 2048, id="equal-cap"),
+        pytest.param(800, True, {"image": 576}, 2048, id="larger-cap"),
+        pytest.param(500, False, {"image": 576}, 2048, id="chunking-allowed"),
+        pytest.param(500, True, {}, 0, id="modalities-disabled"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_mm_prefill_cap_valid_configurations(
+    cap: int,
+    disable_mm_chunking: bool,
+    mm_tokens: dict[str, int],
+    expected_budget: int,
+):
+    config = SchedulerConfig(
+        is_encoder_decoder=False,
+        max_model_len=4096,
+        max_num_batched_tokens=2048,
+        disable_chunked_mm_input=disable_mm_chunking,
+        long_prefill_token_threshold=cap,
+    )
+    assert compute_mm_encoder_budget(config, mm_tokens) == (
+        expected_budget,
+        expected_budget,
+    )
+
+
